title: Both exports reflect the filters and search active at the time of export
permissions_required: Manager or Office User role (Reports section access) plus the Inventory Reports → View permission (S1-R4).
preconditions: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded across types, categories, and locations.
steps: 1. Set a distinctive filter mix: Type = Inventory, a single category, a short date range, and a search string.
2. Download the CSV and open it.
3. Download the PDF and open it.
expected: 1. Both files contain only the rows matching the date range, type, category, vendor, bin, location, and search active at export time - not a full unfiltered dump.
2. The exported rows match what the on-screen grid was showing.
